steps.content: [Background - Overcast Refugee Camp]

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: Huh? When did the sky get so dark...? Gotta hurry back and help everyone bring in their laundry!

steps.speaker: Thani
steps.content: I hope Hella's doing okay...
[Background - Underground Experiment Site]

The site has been thoroughly cleaned. Through the open skylights, the last lingering rays of amber sunlight pierce the laboratory, pooling at the feet of Hella, who had infiltrated the ritual site long before.
Suspended in the open space above, the Cocoon looms, larger now than when last seen. Its pulsations have grown more violent, its fractured shell leaking streams of Mania.
Beneath it, a lone figure stands in silent anticipation.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You're late, Synex.
Facing the stern young man, Synex merely shrugs, her hands spreading in a gesture of deliberate indifference.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Heh... You need a lucky hour for a suicide mission? What's the difference if I'm early or late? All that matters is that I'm here... right?
With a flick of her wrist, the shackles around her arm clink tight, along with the clasp coiled around her tail.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Don't worry. This dog leash is still on. I'm not going anywhere.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: That's not what I meant... never mind.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: The ritual is about to begin. Go now, they're waiting for you.
Footsteps echo across the floor. Hella holds her breath, peering through a crack between the stonework.
Saffar steps aside, no longer blocking Synex's path. With this, Synex begins walking forward.
And then, like a formal declaration of the ritual's commencement, he cedes the stage to the figure bound in shackles.
—Thud!
Synex advances, her steps measured and deliberate. Each footfall is a silent herald of fate's approach.
—Thud!

With every stride, the resonance between her and the Cocoon deepens. The Mania in the air swells, invisible flames lashing at Hella's senses. She grits her teeth, cursing quietly while choking on the searing pressure.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the ****... Is this really just a test explosion?!
As if sensing Synex's approach, the Cocoon suspended in midair writhes violently. Something inside thrashes against its confines, straining to break free.

The Aurum Secretum devices at the four corners of the site let out an overloaded hum. Hella feels a prickle of awareness—eyes upon the site. She looks up and spots an observation chamber high above, filled with robed figures. Clad in white, their faces hidden behind expressionless masks, they stand in perfect rows, watching the scene below with detached scrutiny.
The leader lifts a hand. Instantly, the Mania surges. The figure in the testing area convulses, then releases a guttural, inhuman shriek.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Nnghh...!
The experiment isn't over. She has to keep moving.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Aahhh... AAAAAAHHHHH!!!

Aurum Secretum floods Synex's veins, erupting from her fingertips in jagged bursts. Her flesh splits, reforms, splits again—an agonizing cycle of destruction and reconstruction, just as it has a thousand times before.
The Mania in the air swells, oppressive and suffocating. Hella's fingers tremble. She knows it's time to go.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Everyone's too wrapped up in the ritual to notice me. Without Horo and the others, there's no chance I can fight them all alone... Yeah, I should just slip away in the chaos. That's the smart play...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tch... Move, damn legs! Wasn't I supposed to run? I'm the queen of getting the hell out! Ugh, why can't I move an inch now?!
Everyone's attention is fixed on the Cocoon and Synex. This is the perfect moment for her to slip away.
Thump!
Synex takes another step forward, sending violent waves of Mania rippling outward. A shadow streaks past Saffar—a blur of motion—hurtling straight toward the apex of the testing site.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...?! An intruder! Is that... the DisCity Sinner?!
Hella grits her teeth, fighting against the crushing tide of Mania. Every step is a battle, her body straining as if wading through an invisible mire.
The Cocoon pulses, sensing the threat. Around her, the Mania swells, a suffocating wave that drags her back into disorientation.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Move... MOVE!!
But the deeper she pushes, the heavier Mania clings—sapping her will, devouring her resolve. Her thoughts fracture; her limbs grow leaden.
The power she hoped to rely on, the Mania coiled inside her, does nothing. Against the Cocoon's overwhelming force, it's utterly weak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Damn it... Is this really... all I've got...
Can't she even cause a tiny bit of trouble?
Suddenly, her fall is halted. Someone has grabbed her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: How touching. I never thought the little rat would actually scurry in here to help me...
Synex's voice reaches her ear, carrying that familiar tone of mockery.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: But now's not the time. You've still got work to do.
Before Hella can react, an overwhelming force seizes her arm.
(Add a vibration sound effect!)
The power of Aurum Secretum erupts from Synex's body like a tidal wave, its power resonating violently with the surrounding machinery.

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: This is no good! She's channeling the Aurum Secretum power!

steps.speaker: Institute Guard
steps.content: Subject is rioting! Abort the ritual! Stop the experiment! Suppress the subject now!!
Someone realizes Synex's intentions, but it's already too late.
[CG - Synex hurling Hella away, modified key visual]
Hella's body is hurled skyward, her world spinning wildly as the whistling wind and panicked screams below blur into chaos.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Synex?! What are you do—
Countless Aurum Secretum chains ensnare Synex, dragging her toward the abyss. Yet in her final moments, she lifts her head, watching Hella soar.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Go, Hella. Don't look back. You've got bigger things to do than rot in here!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Get that message out, then raise hell for me. And when you do? Kick their asses hard! I've left you all the goodies I've been stashing away...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Make sure they don't go to waste, okay?
Before Hella can even utter a word, the chains swallow Synex whole, and she vanishes into the metal mass.
